verdict.rationale: Pika documents generating clips and videos from user-supplied references, and its Short Film app lets you set a style and add references. However, no evidence explicitly says it extracts the visual style of a reference video or image and applies it to new footage. Motion Transfer copies movement, not style, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: explicit reference-to-style transfer for video, documentation of how a reference's style is matched, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: Create short clips or full videos from your references
Set the style and add references to develop a script, storyboard and film with multiple shots.
